Let's be honest: getting divorced on a budget is like trying to eat a whole pizza while juggling three flaming torches and a leaking faucet. You aren't just splitting assets; you are splitting your dignity, your dignity, and maybe a half-eaten bagel. If you are staring at a stack of bills that looks like a mountain range made of red ink, you need a lawyer who understands that your "high net worth" consists mostly of expired coupons and a very emotional cat.

*We don't charge hourly rates that will bankrupt you before the first hearing.* Instead, we operate on a sliding scale so low that even the IRS would feel guilty about our fees. We know the struggle of hiding assets in old shoeboxes labeled "Emergency Fund" while your ex-spy is already in the next room.

*Our courtroom strategy involves more negotiation than a toddler trying to share a single slice of pepperoni.* We will fight for your custody rights with the same ferocity you use to defend your right to a warm blanket on a freezing night.

*Finally, we will help you navigate the legal limbo without eating your own lawyer's lunch.* Stop worrying about the fine print and start worrying about how to afford the next bus fare. Call us today for a consultation that costs less than a cup of coffee. Your future self will thank you, even if they are currently hiding in the basement.
